character.name: Sebak
character.title: The Crow in the Wind
character.lineage: Half-Uchiha (Son of Uchiha Itachi) / Unknown Maternal Bloodline

alar.notes: 1 firm Alar binding in combat (scales with Intelligence and University training)

features.name: Body Flicker (Shunshin)
features.description: Teleport/dash up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Chakra-Fuelled Link
features.description: Act as a pure, lossless thermal/kinetic source for a Sympathetic binding for 1 round, bypassing the need for a fire or the risk of Binder's Chills.

features.name: Precision Throw
features.description: Curve a thrown kunai/dagger around half or three-quarters cover, granting Advantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Setting a Binding
features.description: Bonus action to set up, whatever the link quality. Roll an Alar check: d20 + INT + proficiency, plus WIS when focused (lost if you took damage or were grappled since your last turn; advantage after a calm round of preparation). DC by link: Perfect 8, Good 11, Poor 15. A failure means slippage and a partial effect, not a miss. A binding acting on a person lets them save against your Sympathy DC. Maintaining it is free but occupies your one mental split. Shares your bonus action with Body Flicker.

features.name: Link Efficiency
features.description: Perfect Link (same piece of matter): DC 8, ~80-90%. Good Link (similar material, or blood/hair for organic targets): DC 11, ~40-60%. Poor Link (crude similarity): DC 15, ~5-15%, high slippage.

features.name: Binder's Chills
features.description: Drawing heat from your own body requires a CON save (DC 10 + energy level) or take 1d4 cold damage and 1 level of Exhaustion.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1d6)
features.description: Extra 1d6 damage when hitting with a Finesse/Ranged weapon with Advantage, or when an ally (or an active Sympathetic kinetic binding distracting the target) is within 5 ft. of the enemy.

features.name: Uchiha Dormancy (Sharingan)
features.description: The Sharingan is locked. Extreme emotional trauma or life-or-death catalysis may awaken it.

features.name: Unknown Maternal Bloodline
features.description: Passive triggers observed by the DM during high-stress physical or sympathetic events. Surrounding matter hums and vibrates. Stirred at the brink of death at the felled oak: iron and wood within reach rang and the nearest club shattered. It drained his chakra and left him exhausted. Its nature is still unknown.

items.name: Small iron key on a cord
items.notes: Taken from the crossbowman; fits something unknown

items.name: Watch receipt for a light crossbow and 7 bolts
items.notes: Held a month at the south gate by Sergeant Voss; the crossbowman's, taken in defence of the cart

keepsakes: Small wooden amulet containing a single black crow feather (mother's warning)

world.location: Imre, in the back room of the apothecary's shop with Bram

companions.name: Bram
companions.notes: Portly tinker driving a mule-drawn wagon from Crosson. Awake and lucid on a cot in the apothecary's back room; fever hanging on but under treatment. His small, iron-bound, locked strongbox is under the wagon bench, untouched; he is anxious about it.

encounter.title: Surprise Round: Felled Oak Ambush

enemies.name: Crossbowman
enemies.position: At the foot of the ash tree
enemies.notes: Still unconscious; stripped of his crossbow and purse, but left one jot

environment: Lit brass whale-oil lantern hanging on Bram's wagon next to Sebak (steady thermal source)

last_log: Sebak returns to the apothecary's with a late aster for the girl and sits with Bram, who is awake.
notes:
COSTINGS (GM reference, using the player's table of the Cealdish system). 10 drabs = 1 jot, 10 jots = 1 talent (100 drabs), 10 talents = 1 mark. Below the drab is the shim (an iron scrap by weight, ~11-14 to a drab). Compound prices like 'two and four' mean talents and jots. Benchmarks: 1 drab = casual stake, 3-4 drabs = a big meal, 5 drabs = road provisions at an Imre inn. 1 jot = Eolian cover or work aprons; 1-2 jots = a student's weekly wage; 2 jots = wagon passage; 3 jots = a sturdy second-hand cloak. 1 talent = a University term's room and board, or good shoes. 2-3 talents = average tuition. 8-10 talents = a quality steel crossbow or a master lute. Price new things in drabs and jots by default. PRICES RESET (the player agreed to a fair readjustment): barge-guard day job = 2 jots + board. Apothecary in Imre = 3 jots for the first treatment (she returned 7 jots of the talent Sebak paid, saying Sebak's field stitching saved her work), then 5 drabs/day for bed and physic, hay 2 drabs/day. Bram's promised pay for the road to Imre = a few jots wage plus about a talent as a thank-you bonus if he recovers. Sebak's looted light crossbow is ordinary, not 'quality steel': about 2-3 talents to a buyer. The player wants tuition to stay hard to afford.

STORY THREADS: Bram's strongbox (small, iron-bound, locked, heavy, under the wagon bench) and the crossbowman's iron key (scar down left cheek, aimed at Bram, patient, likely hired). Whether the key fits the strongbox is undecided; do not confirm until the player asks Bram. Voss (south gate sergeant) is sending men for the bodies; the dead brigand may be Garrick Finch (missing front tooth, left forearm tattoo) with a bounty on the roll; the fled one is heavy-set, brown patched coat, broken nose, stubble, headed east, lost his club. Crossbow and 7 bolts held by Voss for a month on a receipt.

player_notes.title: Notice by the apothecary's door
player_notes.text: Chalked on slate by the door of the apothecary's shop in Imre: "Guards wanted for river barge, Thursday. Ask at the wharf. Two jots and board." At the wharf (a short walk east of the south gate): the barge is the Wren, a long flat grain boat, tied up in the third row. Her captain is sour-faced and still counting heads; he would take me on at two jots and board. Thursday's departures are chalked on the dockmaster's post, and the dockmaster is a loud man in an oilskin cloak.

player_notes.title: Sergeant Haldric Voss, south gate watch
player_notes.text: The apothecary says to report the fight on the road to the watch at Imre's south gate and ask for Sergeant Haldric Voss by name. Big, grey-bearded, limps from an old campaign (says he got it at Vint, tells it differently each time). Likes things said plainly and in order, doesn't like being hurried. A bounty may come of it if reported today. Tell him only that I found three bandits and left. Keep quiet about the sympathy.

player_notes.title: Ask Bram about the strongbox and the key
player_notes.text: Speak to Bram about his strongbox and the small iron key. Are they related? The strongbox is small, iron-bound, locked and heavy, kept under the bench of his wagon (still untouched, and Bram was anxious about it when he woke and again at the apothecary's). The key is plain, finger-length, with a worn bow, odd teeth and no maker's mark; I took it from the scar-faced crossbowman, who aimed at Bram and not at me. Voss thinks he was hired and warned me not to show the key about Imre.
